auth.label: AK (Access Key)
auth.description: Baidu Maps AK passed via the ak query parameter. Create or manage keys in the official console: https://lbsyun.baidu.com/apiconsole/key. Provide an SK in the optional field when your application requires SN validation.

extraFields.label: SK (Secret Key)
extraFields.description: The SK is used only to compute the SN signature locally; it is never sent to Baidu. Baidu's SN check is an AK-level setting (chosen in the console as the AK's request-verification method), so when an SK is provided every request is signed automatically. Leave blank when your AK uses IP-whitelist verification instead of SN.

actions.name: weather
actions.description: Fetch weather observations and forecasts for a coordinate.

coordtype.description: The coordinate system of the input location (weather uses 'coordtype', default wgs84).

location.description: The coordinate as longitude,latitude — NOTE weather is lng,lat (opposite of other endpoints). Provide this or district_id.

district_id.description: The administrative division code (adcode). Provide this or location; takes priority.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for the weather API.

status.description: The Baidu Maps status code (0 means success).

now.description: The current weather observation (data_type includes 'now' or 'all').

items.description: One day of the daily forecast (data_type includes 'fc' or 'all').
One hour of the hourly forecast (data_type includes 'fc_hour' or 'all').
One weather alert/warning (request data_type 'alert' or 'all'; response key is 'alerts').
